values.meaning: Magic damage to enemies passing through the perimeter blades
values.quote: dealt the same {{as|magic damage}} and are {{tip|slow|slowed}}

values.meaning: Duration the perimeter/zone remains active, during which it can deal its damage
values.quote: forming a spade-shaped perimeter around the enemy champion hit for {{fd|2.5}} seconds

mechanics.claim: The initial hit and the later perimeter-crossing hit are separate damage instances, each dealing the full listed magic damage, and the perimeter only damages each enemy the first time it crosses.
mechanics.quote: Enemies that pass through the blades for the first time are dealt the same {{as|magic damage}} and are {{tip|slow|slowed}} by 90% for {{fd|1.5}} seconds.

mechanics.claim: The perimeter/zone still forms and can deal its damage even if the champion hit by the initial blades is protected by a spell shield (which would block only the initial hit).
mechanics.quote: The blades will still expand if the champion hit by the blades is protected by a {{tip|spell shield}}.

mechanics.claim: The damage from the blades after they land on the ground (the zone/perimeter damage) is tagged as indirect damage, distinct from the initial projectile hit.
mechanics.quote: The damage dealt by the blades after they land on the ground is additionally tagged as {{tip|indirect damage|indirect}}.
